title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging of the Knee

criteria.summary: Mechanical symptoms or instability on examination
Weight-bearing radiographs within 60 days before the MRI
At least 4 weeks of conservative therapy without improvement

passages.text: This policy applies to outpatient professional claims for MRI of a lower-extremity joint without contrast, CPT 73721, when performed for the knee, with dates of service on or after July 1, 2026.
Knee MRI is considered medically necessary when criteria 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3 are all met.
The member has knee pain with mechanical symptoms, such as locking or catching, or with instability found on examination.
Weight-bearing radiographs of the knee were obtained within 60 days before the MRI.
The member has completed at least 4 weeks of conservative therapy, such as physical therapy, bracing, activity modification, or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, without improvement.

Documentation supporting each applicable criterion must be available in the medical record on request. Absence of documentation for a required criterion does not establish that the criterion was not met.
